values.meaning: stacks of Grandmaster-at-Arms needed before the empowered on-hit consumes them, outside the active swing's buff window
values.binNote: No data value for this threshold appears in the sheet. The wiki's own texts disagree: the detailed description says stacks cap at 2 and the proc consumes 'At 2 stacks'; the short blurb2 instead says the passive normally applies 'every 3' stacks (see r_4 and the blurb2 quote in mechanics). Using the detailed description's number here.

values.meaning: stacks needed to trigger the empowered on-hit while Grandmaster-at-Arms' active swing buff is up (reduced threshold)
values.quote: the empowered attack triggers at 1 stack instead.
values.binNote: No data value for this threshold appears in the sheet. Same wiki-internal disagreement as r_3: blurb2 states this reduced, active-window threshold is 'every 2' rather than 1. Using the detailed description's number here.

values.meaning: seconds a Grandmaster-at-Arms stack lasts before falling off, refreshed on each on-hit
values.quote: for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits

mechanics.claim: Grandmaster-at-Arms' on-hit proc (Additional Magic Damage) and its active swing (Magic Damage) are independent effects: the on-hit stacks and consumes from basic attacks on its own timer, while the swing is a separate AoE cast on R's own cooldown.
mechanics.quote: The on-hit deals {{tip|proc damage}}. The swing deals {{tip|area damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The wiki's short blurb and its detailed description disagree on the on-hit's stack threshold: blurb2 says the passive normally procs every 3 stacks (every 2 while the swing's buff is active); the description instead says stacks cap at 2 and the proc consumes at 2 stacks (1 while active).
mechanics.quote: He applies his passive {{tip|on-hit}} every 2 stacks instead of every 3 while active.

mechanics.claim: The empowered on-hit attack is applied as a damage instance separate from Jax's basic attack, not merged into it.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack is applied in a separate damage instance from '''Jax's''' basic attacks.

mechanics.claim: Grandmaster-at-Arms' cooldown starts immediately on cast, not after its effect resolves (unlike Empower and Counter Strike, which start post-effect).
The active swing's damage lands when the 0.25s cast time ends, not at the instant of casting.
